title: Chuyên đề thực tế ngành Kiểm toán

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Describe business conditions, organizational structure, and identify the role and function of auditing and internal control in the unit.
Evaluate strengths and weaknesses regarding issues in accounting, auditing, and internal control activities of the unit.
Possess writing skills for reports related to specialized topics in auditing and internal control.
Possess independent work skills, effective teamwork, professionalism, and high adaptability in work.
Practice self-study, accumulate experience, and draw lessons from issues in auditing and internal control activities.
Express and defend personal views based on an objective and scientific approach.
